note: The cutting rules ship as Sources/PhotonzCore/ClipPieces.swift with 45 tests written first (Tests/PhotonzCoreTests/ClipPiecesTests.swift), commit eea276fe, pushed to main. A clip is a list of pieces laid back to back: split at a moment (either half splits again, nothing copied), reorder (what plays and what an export writes follow, nothing else to change), remove (the gap closes and everything after slides up, the same rule as lengthening), trim either edge reversibly, hold on a frame (a piece whose start and end in the recording are the same moment, silent, otherwise like any other piece), and give a piece a speed (it keeps the frames, changes how long they take, and its sound goes with the picture). The pieces hang off the layer as an optional Layer.cuts per D18, nil for every clip nobody has cut, so an uncut clip writes nothing extra and old documents read back identical. Each edit is one History.perform step, so each is one undo - all six tested.
